build.buildCommand: corepack enable && cd packages/db && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec prisma generate --config prisma.config.ts && cd ../../lodgist && npm ci && npm run build

deploy.preDeployCommand: cd packages/db && pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.config.ts
deploy.startCommand: HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 sh -c 'cd lodgist && npx next start --port "$PORT"'
